notes.title: Official Game Guide Now Available!
notes.content:
By popular demand, the Official Game Guide for [i]Fractal: Make Blooms Not War[/i] is now available at [url=http://www.cipherprime.com/games/fractal/guide/]CipherPrime.com[/url]. This guide covers the mechanics and metrics for the different types of fractals, blooms, and game modes available.

For anyone interested in gameplay videos, check out these two on YouTube:
[list][*][i][url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QqQakZNQqTA]First Impressions of Fractal[/url][/i] by PitFire Gaming[/*][*][i][url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2D4EdnuGDwk]Fractal Gameplay Video Feature[/url][/i] by Giant Bomb[/*][/list]
